
fpgui_ide.lpk
  This package adds a new project type in the Lazarus IDE.
  So you can then create a fpGUI based project by 
  going: 'File | New' and selecting 'fpGUI Application'.

The former FPCUnit runner integration is retired. Its original source is
archived in Nexus projects/nxtest/retained/review. Retained suites use nxtest.

  Regards,
    Graeme.
